capability: Prevent the canonical dotnet restore lane from racing pristine-worktree structure validation
searchEvidence: Canonical verify --all started structure, python, and dotnet concurrently; dotnet restore changed the tracked Cli lockfile while structure inspected the worktree.
The resulting structure failure named only src/NvtFwCombiner.Cli/packages.lock.json, whose restore diff removed the empty win-x64 target.

terminalContract: A public plan containing structure and dotnet completes isolated structure validation before any restore-capable lane starts, then runs the unchanged remaining lanes with the requested jobs and timeout; structure failure starts no later phase, while plans lacking either lane retain one-phase execution
